hero.title: Pickles, spices & flours — made the old way.
hero.body: We grind spices by hand and jar pickles the way our grandmother taught us. No shortcuts, no factories — just good food made with patience.
hero.imageAlt: Acharya's Classic Pickles — Mixed, Green Chilli, and Mango varieties arranged with fresh ingredients on a wooden table

story.lead: Mrs. Laxmi Acharya starts making pickles in her kitchen in Chitwan, the way her grandmother did.
story.title: Three generations. One kitchen. Same recipes.
paragraphs: Neighbours kept asking for more. Friends wanted jars for their families. Before long, what was a home recipe became something bigger.

Twenty years later, not much has changed. We still pick the ingredients ourselves and follow the same recipes. The kitchen is bigger, but the hands and the heart behind every jar are still the same family.
Every product is free of artificial colours, flavours and preservatives.

steps.text: If it takes three days, we take three days

products.name: Mango Pickle
products.description: Made from fresh raw mangoes, mustard oil, timur and a handful of spices we've been using for 20 years. Goes with everything.

products.name: Chilli Pickle
products.description: For those who like it hot. Fresh green chillies, garlic, mustard seeds, and local spices ground together. Not for the faint-hearted.

products.name: Mixed Vegetable Pickle
products.description: A bit of everything — seasonal vegetables pickled in mustard oil with our family spice blend. Different every batch, always good.

products.name: Buckwheat Flour
products.description: Stone-ground from locally grown buckwheat. Perfect for dhido, roti, or anything that needs proper flour with real nutrition.

products.name: Roasted Corn
products.description: Crunchy roasted corn with a touch of salt and spice. The snack our grandparents grew up on — simple, honest, and addictive.

products.name: Roasted Batmas
products.description: High-protein roasted soybeans seasoned the Nepali way. Great with tea, great with beer, great on their own.

products.name: Millet Flour
products.description: Finger millet flour, rich in calcium and iron. The base for traditional dhido — our comfort food, ground fresh.

products.name: Ajina Moto
products.description: The umami boost every Nepali kitchen needs. A pinch transforms chowmein, momo, fried rice, and practically anything savoury.

products.name: Chatpat Masala
products.description: Our tangy-spicy seasoning blend. Toss it on fruit, mix it into chatpate, sprinkle it on anything that needs a kick.
